title: China's 3 AM Sunrise or Its Aurora: Which Edge Would You Drive? | China Travel Expert
description:
Two ends of China's far northeast — pick one. Chase a 3 AM sunrise in the east, or the aurora up north?

Fuyuan is China's "East Pole," the first place in the country to see the sun each day. Because all of China runs on a single Beijing time zone, midsummer dawn there comes around 3 AM. Go the other way and you reach Mohe, China's northernmost town and its best shot at seeing the aurora on a clear winter night. Two frontiers, one epic border road trip — so which edge are you driving to?

🧭 Expert Tip: Time it right — Fuyuan for the earliest sunrises around the summer solstice, Mohe for the long dark nights of deep winter when the aurora is most likely.

中国的两个'极'：东极抚远，全国同一时区，盛夏日出近凌晨3点；最北漠河，中国最可能看到极光的地方。你会先去哪一头？
